## What this changes

## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `gofmt`, `go vet` and `go test` pass
- [ ] No breaking change to the theme or plugin interface (or `engine_api` bumped, with a deprecation warning)
- [ ] User-supplied text is sanitized, and no new third-party request reaches readers
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated
